item.title: Woman Goes From Psychiatric “Nurse” To Psychiatric Patient After Her Boyfriend Finds Out Her Secret
item.description: She didn't even need to say she was a nurse. There were medical books all over the apartment, she came home wearing scrubs, and he'd fetched her at her place of work (a prestigious hospital) on more than one occasion. Imagine his confusion when his EMT friend raised concerns that the woman may very well have been lying about her profession. The guy has revealed how he was left terrified when the truth finally came out.

item.title: 85 Times Men’s Hilariously Awkward Body Language Gave Women The Ick
item.description: We all have those moments when we end up sitting in a weird position or sleeping in a way that looks unique. Some postures are just habits, some are about comfort, and some are little quirks that others might not get. And yes, sometimes they even give someone a tiny case of the ick — even if it’s totally harmless. The best part? All that awkwardness makes for some truly entertaining sights. Women on TikTok are now sharing the funniest photos of the men in their lives caught in the weirdest poses

item.title: “Now I Suffer From PTSD”: 68 People Who’ve Been In A Coma Reveal What It Was Like
item.description: Most of us are fortunate enough to associate being in a coma with something we’ve only seen on TV or in movies. It looks terrifying, and it’s something you wouldn’t wish on your worst enemy. But sadly, it does happen in real life. People who have survived comas have been opening up online about their experiences, so we’ve gathered a list of their stories right here.

item.title: Woman Breaks Down The Pros And Cons Of Platonic Co-Parenting As She Considers Having Baby With Ex
item.description: She thought she didn't want kids but as she approached 40, she changed her mind. She doesn't want to be a single mom and she also doesn't want to be in a relationship. Now, she's considering having a baby with her ex-boyfriend, and entering into a "platonic co-parenting" situationship. People are divided...

item.title: 33 Stories About Friends Who Looked Innocent But Were Hiding Skeletons In Their Closet
item.description: You never really know someone well enough, even those you’ve considered a friend and spent a large chunk of your time with. Some are extremely adept at hiding their sinister selves, much like what these people on Reddit experienced. Scroll through, but be forewarned that these stories go from 0 to 100 really quickly.

item.title: 51 Terrible Book Covers That You Can’t Help But Judge (New Pics)
item.description: They say that you shouldn’t judge a book by its cover. The internet disagrees! Some cover designs are so terrible, so ridiculously nonsensical, that they’re actually entertaining. It’s any person with taste’s duty to make fun of them. ‘Terrible Book Covers’ is one of the most fun niches on the internet. item.title: 104 Funny And Harmless Conspiracy Theories That Might Lighten Up The Mood
item.description: Did you know Ireland doesn’t actually exist and lint rollers are secretly designed to leave your clothes stickier so they pick up more lint, forcing you to buy refills forever? Okay, fine… none of this has been proven. Yet. But these are exactly the kind of silly, harmless theories people love to debate on r/LowStakesConspiracies. You won’t find aliens or government cover-ups here, but you will find plenty of laughs.

item.title: 51 Red Flags That Got People Running Away After The First Date
item.description: An average date lasts up to two hours. But for these folks, that was more than enough to understand that they would never want to see their date again. Folks online recently have been sharing the first date moments they knew there would never be a second. For some, it was something the other person. For other, it was how they acted. Nevertheless, some of these romantic prospects gave people the ick in record time.

item.title: 25 People Share The Biggest Losers In History
item.description: History is full of stories about the world's greatest winners. But what about those who came and saw and failed spectacularly? The ones who lost wars, money, friends, their reputation and sometimes, their dignity. While it's never nice to celebrate anyone's misfortunes, some are just so legendary that they need to be noted. Here are a few of the world's biggest losers...

item.title: 43 Healthcare Memes That You Might Enjoy, Unless You’re From The US
item.description: Sure, some countries do it better than others, but it would be pretty hard to find a healthcare system without any flaws. Whether it's piles of administrative work for doctors, or long hours in the waiting room for patients, there’s bound to be problems. So, we put together a list of memes capturing the weird, stressful, and even hilarious aspects of life in and around hospitals. After all, laughter is the best medicine (which is easy to say when you have antibiotics).
